summary: Sheet #58 (Freemium Trial, Demo Mode & Conversion Engine) + NEW DELETE /api/projects/{id} — 19/19 backend pytest cases PASSED (100%). Coverage: /entitlements/me shape validation (plan, caps, usage, remaining, trial_days_left, upgrade_cta, price_label all present + correct types); /entitlements/consume decrements per-feature counters and returns {ok:false,locked:true,upgrade_cta} when cap reached (tested by temporarily zeroing caps via admin PUT and restoring); invalid feature -> 400; /demo/templates returns kitchen+fence; /demo/start/demo-kitchen-remodel idempotent (2nd call returns existing:true with same project_id); unknown slug -> 404; /demo/commit converts is_demo=false, second commit -> 404, unknown id -> 404; /conversion/event returns ok for demo_start/cta_view/cta_click; admin/freemium/config GET+PUT roundtrip preserved and restored; non-admin (demo_home) hitting /admin/freemium/config -> 403; admin/freemium/analytics returns totals + 5-stage funnel with all expected stages; NEW DELETE /api/projects/{id} — owner deletes own project (returns {ok:true, deleted:pid}), project removed from GET list, second DELETE -> 404, unknown id -> 404, cross-user attempt (demo_home deleting admin-owned project) -> 404 and project still exists for admin. Frontend code review: UpgradeBanner (testID='upgrade-banner') rendered inline in profile.tsx line 170; DemoBanner (testID='demo-banner', 'demo-commit') gated by is_demo flag in project/[id].tsx line 206; FreemiumModule with testIDs freemium-{key}, freemium-cta, freemium-price, freemium-save wired correctly to /admin/freemium/{config,analytics}. All endpoints properly reachable from the frontend components. Frontend E2E via Playwright did not complete a full login flow (app's login screen is not at /login and the login form testIDs used by the auth screen were not visible on the /login URL — auth screen appears to live under /onboarding or a modal, out of scope for this iteration's blocker) — but code review + all backend calls confirm the wiring. Auth login POST returns {access_token, ...} (not 'token') — noted in test harness.
action_items: (Optional) Consider surfacing the Upgrade CTA in more discoverable spots than just the Profile menu list (currently sandwiched between Loyalty and Try a Demo menu rows) — the banner is visually strong but placement mid-menu may reduce conversion.

(Optional) /demo/commit currently returns {ok:true} without echoing the new project_id or is_demo status — consumer must reload. Consider returning the updated project doc for smoother UX in DemoBanner.commit().

(Optional) /entitlements/consume accepts both 'scan'/'scans' and 'guide'/'guides' — align docs/frontend on singular form (currently DemoBanner/frontend calls not sending these; only integrated via /projects/*/guide etc.). Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DELETE /api/projects/{id}: owner-scoped find_one + delete_one both filter by user_id — correct 404 semantics for cross-user access (verified in tests). Also cascades to db.timeline.delete_many with same user_id filter — good.
server.py /entitlements/me computes trial_days_left from user['created_at'] via datetime.fromisoformat — resilient to bad data via try/except fallback to cfg['trial_days']. Good defensive coding.

server.py /entitlements/consume: when _is_paid returns True short-circuits to {ok:true, unlimited:true} without touching Mongo — efficient. When free and at cap, returns 200 with {ok:false, locked:true} rather than 402/403 — appropriate for a soft paywall.

server.py /demo/start uses find_one({kit_slug: slug, is_demo:true}) for idempotency — but after commit (is_demo becomes false), a subsequent /demo/start/{same slug} will create a NEW demo project (existing:false) since the filter requires is_demo:true. This is probably intended behavior (user committed one, now wants a fresh demo) but worth confirming.

server.py admin/freemium/analytics uses async generator `async for p in db.projects.find(...)` inside a set comprehension — works but is an unusual pattern. Consider `distinct('user_id', {'is_demo': {'$ne': True}})` for clarity/perf on larger datasets.
server.py /demo/commit does not log conversion event on 404 path (correct — only successful commits count toward funnel). ✓
FreemiumConfigReq is a hard schema (all fields required) — PUT must send full object, which the frontend module does via {...cfg, [field]:new}. Good.
DemoBanner uses <Alert.alert> which is React Native only — fine for mobile but on web Alert.alert opens a browser confirm dialog. Non-blocking; existing pattern in this codebase.
